response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced full-stack and systems engineer with some geospatial (GIS) domain exposure and past C/C++ work, but his current expertise centers on JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and web platforms, with no recent or deep C++/Rust systems programming, no distributed-systems/routing-tile pipeline experience, and no listed skills in C++ or Rust at all despite years of relevant industry experience. This is a significant mismatch for a role requiring modern C++/Rust expertise in a high-performance navigation data pipeline.
strengths: Genuine geospatial/GIS domain experience via GISCollective and Green Map projects
Strong general software engineering craftsmanship (TDD, CI/CD, distributed micro-services at Dunnhumby)
Demonstrated ability to work across diverse stacks and adapt to new technologies
concerns: No C++ or Rust listed in skills; last significant C/C++ work was in 2014-2015 (NI LabWindows/CVI)
No experience with routing tiles, navigation guidance systems, or map data pipelines at production scale
Current and recent roles are heavily focused on TypeScript/Node.js web development, not systems-level or performance-critical engineering
